finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.assumptions: The variable ticksPerSecond is attacker-controlled or can be influenced by user input, and it is used to control the tick rate and update the elapsed time.

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: ability1.damagePerTick or ability2.damagePerTick is very large
finding.assumptions: The damagePerTick values are attacker-controlled or can be influenced by user input, and they are used directly to reduce the dummy's health.

finding.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
finding.trigger: activationCooldown is set to a hardcoded value
finding.assumptions: The activationCooldown variable is hardcoded and not configurable, which might lead to predictable behavior.
